cond_0523.intro: We are looking for a qualified senior cloud ETL tester to ensure quality delivery of end-to-end business solutions and to work with one of the leading healthcare providers. The candidate must possess excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with domain and technical experts in the team.
cond_0523.responsibilities:
Interpret and analyze data from various source systems to support data integration and data reporting needs for Modern Data Platforms
Develop complex code data scripts (Primarily SQL) for ETL (Azure Data bricks/Azure data factory)
Execute testing of data analytics and data integration on time and within budget
Work with team leads to prioritize business and information needs
Troubleshoot & determine the best resolution for data issues and anomalies
Work with business stakeholders, Business Systems Analysts, and Developers to ensure quality delivery of software
Follow quality management best practices and processes to bring consistency and completeness to integration service testing
Design, develop, and implement comprehensive QA test plans and test cases, tools, and infrastructure for assigned areas
Design, develop, automate, monitor, and maintain data quality assurance processes that transfer data to and from internal and external locations
Designing and managing the testing AWS environments of data workflows during the development and deployment of data products
Provide assistance to the team in Test Estimation & Test Planning
Design, and development of Reports and dashboards
Analyzing and evaluating data sources, data volume, and business rules
Drive client discussions and onsite: offshore communications as lead
cond_0523.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Well versed with the Data flow and Test Strategy for ETL Testing (Azure Data bricks/Azure data factory)
Experience in testing Database Applications to validate source-to-destination data movement and transformation
Experience in Functional Testing, Regression Testing, System Testing, Integration Testing & End testing
Deep understanding of data architecture & data modeling best practices and guidelines for different data and analytic platforms
Able to create test data to perform scenario-based functional testing
Proficiency with SQL, NoSQL databases, Python and AWS
Proficiency in Data Bricks/Data Factory and Azure Synapse skills along with PySpark
Expert technical skills with hands-on ETL, API, and Cloud-based applications testing experience
Proficient in reading and writing relational databases (RDBMS) and NoSQL databases
Extensive experience testing DBMS like Oracle, SQL Server, DB2
Extensive experience with both data migration and data transformation testing
Ability to communicate work progress, risks, and strategies in a group setting
Proven written and verbal communication and presentation skills
Ability to problem-solve in time-constrained situations
Preferred Requirements
Experienced in large-scale application development testing
Proficiency in using airflow to schedule and execute jobs
Experience with multi-year, large-scale projects
Experience using both Waterfall and Agile methodologies
Experience with one or more industry-standard defect or Test Case Management Tools: Zephyr, ALM, QC, Jira, Rally, etc.
Ability to communicate effectively with peers and leaders
Proven aptitude in reconciling business requirements with testing requirements
Ability to comprehend high levels of complex details
Detailed, highly organized, and time efficient
Experience in varied technology projects throughout all phases
Ability to conduct usability testing
Proven capability to handle multiple assignments simultaneously

Experience with multi-year, large-scale projects
